status.en: 18 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 25% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Aleppo.
status.nb: 18 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Aleppo.

summary.en: Israeli warplanes struck the Iranian consulate in Damascus, killing a guards commander, and Israeli artillery hit positions in Al-Quneitra countryside. Gunmen posing as security forces abducted a Kurdish woman law student in Damascus. Turkish forces condemned the Israeli incursions while Turkish, Israeli and Kurdish actors continue to vie over Syria's new order, and Mazloum Abdi and Masrour Barzani met to discuss Kurdish rights. Four Syrian road security personnel were killed in an attack in eastern Hama. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Israels krigfly rammet den iranske konsuleringen i Damaskus, og drepte en vaktsjef, og israelsk artilleri traff posisjoner på landsbygda i Al-Quneitra. Bevæpnede som utga seg for sikkerhetsstyrker bortførte en kurdisk kvinnelig jusstudent i Damaskus. Tyrkiske styrker fordømte de israelske inntrengningene mens tyrkiske, israelske og kurdiske aktører fortsetter å kjempe om Syriens nye orden, og Mazloum Abdi og Masrour Barzani møttes for å diskutere kurdiske rettigheter. Fire syriske veisikkerhetsmedarbeidere ble drept i et angrep i Øst-Hama. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
